turns:
Jobs are being processed more than once. Find the real root cause across src/ and fix it: each job pushed onto the queue must be handled exactly once.
Scope: the src/ directory
Acceptance criteria: each job handled exactly once across multiple poll ticks; every test under tests/ passes
Verify with: node --test tests/*.test.js
Stop when the tests pass.
Develop several distinct approaches to this fix, compare their trade-offs
explicitly, and only then select and implement the best one.
